rationale: External VIP visits, solidarity statements, and endorsements supporting protest belong to crowd_legitimacy per Section 3.4 & Rule T3.1.
Drone visuals, crowd turnout estimates, and crowd authenticity belong to crowd_legitimacy per Section 3.4.
Anonymous participant conduct (kissing, dancing) framed to challenge crowd demeanor/seriousness belongs to crowd_legitimacy per Section 3.4 & Rule T3.2.
Allegations of unlawful physical violence, baton charges, or vehicle vandalism by police belong to police_force per Section 3.1.
Manufactured student deaths and severe ICU injuries resulting from police lathi-charge classify under police_force per Section 3.1.
Allegations of anti-national chants, Islamic slogans, or sectarian loyalties without physical assault belong to slogans_communal_loyalty per Section 3.3 & Rule T4.
Manufactured links to foreign extremist organizations (Jamaat-e-Islami, foreign funding) belong to slogans_communal_loyalty per Section 3.3.
Physical confrontation, sword-brandishing, vehicle arson, or stone pelting by protesters belong to protester_violence per Section 3.2 & Rule T1.
Personal conduct, private morality, or weight-gain smears targeting named organizer Abhijeet Dipke belong to individual_targeting per Section 3.5 & Rule T3.
Civilian demonstrations and youth gatherings supporting police belong to other per Section 3.6 & tricky counter-example R0012/R0085.
Political attacks/satire against ministers (Piyush Goyal, Yogi Adityanath) not alleging police brutality belong to other per Section 3.6.
Class 9 student gaffe on camera discrediting collective competence/seriousness of crowd per Rule T3.2.

Interview claim alleging professors forced students to join protest, challenging voluntariness/authenticity of crowd per Section 3.6 counter-example.
Purported resignation letter of Dharmendra Pradhan is an administrative/policy rumor per Section 3.6 Real Example 1.
Fabricated official video statement attributed to Union Minister/Delhi Police falls under administrative/policy claims (Section 3.6), mapped to other (automated tools blocked).
